posts.title: Skilled Trades After 40
posts.feed_problem:
Over 40 and done
with the desk job?
posts.feed_answer: A plain guide to switching into the trades

video_frames.why:
A change is easier
with a clear plan

posts.instagram:
Over 40, done with the desk job, and wondering about the skilled trades?

Skilled Trades After 40 is a practical guide for midlife career changers thinking about leaving a desk job for the skilled trades. It walks through the transition, the apprenticeship pay cut, and the steps involved in building a new career.

If you're weighing training, income and long-term earning potential, it helps you look at the whole picture before you make the move.

🔧 Skilled Trades After 40: How to Leave Your Desk Job, Survive the Apprenticeship Pay Cut, and Build a Path to Six-Figure Income, from ApexLit Publishing
📖 Get it: apexlitpublishinggroup.com/books/78-skilled-trades-after-40/

video_frames.problem:

posts.instagram:
Keeping the whole family safe online feels like a lot to manage?

Cybersecurity for the Modern Family is a practical guide to online safety for households and parents. It covers cybersecurity in everyday family life, from your home and personal identity to your kids and their digital activity.

Read it at your own pace and make online safety part of family time, one conversation at a time.

🛡️ Cybersecurity for the Modern Family: A Practical Guide to Protecting Your Home, Identity, Kids, and Digital Life, from TechVerse Technology Books
